title: Chavo rebels against Eddie’s control
summary: Eddie Guerrero’s mistreatment of his nephew pushes Chavo into rebellion. Their family conflict mixes competitive revenge with Chavo’s increasingly erratic on-screen behavior.

chapters.title: Chavo defeats his uncle
chapters.result: Chavo defeats Eddie in their singles match.
chapters.context: The younger Guerrero finally records a direct victory over the relative trying to control him.

chapters.title: Chavo loses the hair match
chapters.result: Eddie defeats Chavo, who then cuts his own hair.
chapters.context: Chavo’s response denies Eddie the expected satisfaction of publicly humiliating him.
